source: IMF international reserves template (gold in fine troy ounces); price from SPDR Gold Shares net assets per ounce
note: Gold does not change weight with its price, so the change in tonnes is what was bought or sold. The worth columns use each month's market price; the change in worth splits into what was bought or sold, valued at the later price, and the price change on the earlier holding. Reporters file late and some only every quarter, so each month uses every reporter's latest filing at or before it and shows the month it was filed; a filing more than three months old is marked.
